question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Cruel
solution:
The correct answer is** "Sympathetic."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cruel** means having a lack of mercy or kindness towards others. (किसी को शारीरिक अथवा मानसिक पीड़ा देनेवाला; निर्मम, क्रूर)

 
 
• **Example**: *She is very **cruel**__.*
 
 
 
• **Sympathetic** means showing compassion or understanding towards others. (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण, हमदर्द)
 __
 
• **Example**: *We are **sympathetic**__ to that point of view and have the same goals.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of **"Cruel"** is **"Sympathetic."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Sensible** can also mean reasonable or logical. ((व्‍यक्ति और उसका आचरण) तर्क और अनुभव पर आधारित निर्णय करने में समर्थ; समझदार; व्‍यवहार-कुशल)
 
• **Unkind** can also mean unfriendly or unpleasant. (बुरा लगने वाला और अमैत्रीपूर्ण, रूखा और निष्‍ठुर)
 
• **Derogatory** can also mean insulting or offensive. (प्रतिष्ठा रहित, अपमानजनक, अनादरपूर्ण)
